name: Lab 4.3 - Repeat-Cycle Counter
description: A PLC counts actual completed CNC dry strokes and stops a three-cycle reference batch. Commands, machine feedback and counter state have separate owners.

points.name: cycle_request
points.purpose: One accepted-scan batch request; not a cycle completion.

points.name: machine_enabled
points.purpose: Manual process enable; not a safety-rated permissive.

points.name: machine_home
points.purpose: Actual modeled Z head at its raised home endpoint.

points.name: machine_busy
points.purpose: Actual feed, dwell or return phase; remains true for a held partial stroke.

points.name: cycle_done
points.purpose: Completed feed/dwell/return, retained until a sampled low cycle command.

points.name: head_position
points.purpose: Modeled 100 mm head lift: 100 percent is home, 0 percent is work endpoint.

points.name: cycle_active
points.purpose: Machine dry-cycle command; removing it holds motion.

points.name: batch_count
points.purpose: Controller accumulated count, published by the ladder project.

hints: The PLC owns the batch counter. Count cycle_done edges, not a manually toggled count-complete input.
Enable the machine, then issue one START pulse. The explicit reference commands three actual dry strokes.
The modeled Z head feeds 100 mm in 1 s, dwells 0.5 s, and returns in 1 s. These are chosen offline reference values, not an OEM machining specification.

solution.summary: This is an original functional reference for the control concept, not a copy of the photographed solution.
steps: Use a CTU preset three for cycle_done and a sealed batch request gated by machine_enabled and counter not done.
Command cycle_active while the batch is active and cycle_done is false. The sampled low command acknowledges completion before the next cycle.
Publish CTU accumulated count to batch_count and done to cycle_complete. Application Reset clears both plant and controller.
solution.acceptance: One accepted START with enable gives three actual feed/dwell/return cycles, COUNT=3 and batch completion; a held request or command must not add an extra cycle.

machineGuide.purpose: A PLC counts actual completed CNC dry strokes and stops a three-cycle reference batch. Commands, machine feedback and counter state have separate owners.
startConditions: Built-in simulator or an explicitly configured symbolic external controller image.
Author or explicitly open a compatible ladder project; the training editor starts empty.
normalSequence: Watch actual head feed/dwell/return and machine_home, machine_busy and cycle_done feedback.
The explicit reference publishes COUNT 1, 2, 3 and then batch complete; application Reset is required for a new batch.
stopBehavior: Local Stop removes cycle command and holds the exact head/spindle pose; the PLC retains its counter and batch state.
Run resumes the retained batch when enable remains true. Losing enable clears the reference batch latch; a new START is required to resume.
Application Reset clears count/completion, disables the machine, raises the head to home and stays stopped.
faultBehavior: A request without enable does not command a cycle. No vendor alarm, cutting force or material-removal model is implied.
expectedObservations: One accepted START with enable gives three actual feed/dwell/return cycles, COUNT=3 and batch completion; a held request or command must not add an extra cycle.

changedTags: cycle_count_complete removed: cycle_done is actual machine feedback; PLC batch counter owns completion.
